home.description: Carl Avidano’s selected work for Work & Co: research-led product decisions, visual design, interactive tools, and collaboration through implementation.
home.headline: I bring research, visual design, and development together.
home.introduction: Hi, I’m Carl, and I’m excited to apply for the Senior Design Lead role at Work & Co. I bring more than 15 years of experience taking digital projects from early questions through design and implementation. Your emphasis on making products together, with designers staying involved in the details, is what draws me to this opportunity.
home.projectsIntroduction: I’ve selected the following case studies to highlight the work and outcomes most relevant to your team: shaping product direction, developing the visual and interactive details, and working with clients and developers through delivery.
home.who: I’m a New York–based product designer, UX leader, and inclusive design advocate with more than 15 years of experience. As UX/UI Director at Reingold, I led the overall UX strategy for the redesign of Phoenix.gov, serving more than 1.5 million residents. My work there also included the NFL, St. Jude Global, and Maximus. Since 2011, I’ve run Avidano Digital, building long-term partnerships with nonprofit and education clients.
home.what: I lead product design from research and early concepts through visual design and implementation. I work through interactions in wireframes, explain decisions to clients, and refine the experience with developers. I stay hands-on in Figma and front-end code while guiding designers and building accessible components that teams can reuse.
